name: Pre-Hispanic City and National Park of Palenque
description: Palenque is a Maya city in the rainforest of Chiapas, southern Mexico, where pale stone temples and a tall-towered palace rise from the jungle. It flourished between AD 500 and 700 and is known for refined architecture and delicate carved reliefs. Visitors can see the Temple of the Inscriptions, where the great ruler Pakal was buried, though most of the city is still hidden beneath the trees.
